description: This file defines the CustomerApproval controller class for the admin section of an OpenCart project. It manages customer approval processes, including listing approval requests, approving, and denying them, with methods for rendering views, handling user actions, and interacting with models.

classes.name: CustomerApproval
classes.description: Controller class for managing customer approval requests in the admin backend, providing methods to list, approve, and deny customer approval entries.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initial method to setup the customer approval page, load language, models, and render the view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a list of customer approvals, primarily a shortcut to getList.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML view for listing customer approval requests, with filtering and pagination.

methods.name: approve
methods.description: Handles approval action for selected customer approval requests, modifying customer status via the model.

methods.name: deny
methods.description: Handles denial of customer approval requests, updating status via the model.
